lines.vo: They met sitting side by side at a church youth event.
They dated all through high school.
Then college pulled them apart. They lost touch.
Years later, Steve lost his wife to cancer.
Then one day, he noticed something on LinkedIn.
Terry had looked at his profile.
He wrote: Hey Terry, this is the Steve Downey you used to know.
In 2015, they got married. Forty-four years after they first met.
